params.name: bet
params.desc: a / b (the better hand; a tie pushes), tie, or pairplus_a / pairplus_b (paid on that hand's category)

note: shuffle(52) over 51 words; card c = rank c%13 (0=A..12=K), suit c//13; Player A = order[0,2,4], Player B = order[1,3,5]; strength = (rank-1) mod 13 (aces high); a hand's key is (category, tie-breakers) — Trail (s), Pure Sequence / Sequence (run: A-K-Q 13, A-2-3 12, else the top strength), Color / High Card (strengths high to low), Pair (pair, kicker); the greater key wins, equal keys tie. a/b pay floor((rtp·total − tie·1e8)/win) and push (1x) on a tie; tie pays floor(rtp·total/tie); pairplus pays ppWeight[category]·floor(hands·rtp/ppWeightedHands) on its player's hand.
